title: Chapter 275 The Battle Of The Blood Sword
content:
Chapter 275 The Battle Of The Blood Sword

"Take me with you fellow daoist, I'll come to help you when I'm here!"

Several deep voices sounded behind Qianye, which made his face happy, and his eager heart couldn't help but slow down.

Although his internal energy is now shallow and not as strong as before, it is still possible to sustain it for a period of time.

And it takes a few breaths of time before the help behind him will arrive. At that time, nearly a hundred first-class masters will deal with Li Cheng together. No matter how strong he is, he will have to hold grudges here.

This is nearly a hundred people, not those ordinary disciples, whose strength is only second or third rate. They are all first-class masters who have comprehended their own unique will, and they are masters who can start a sect and pass on their unique knowledge wherever they are placed.

If such a force is really gathered, it will be enough to move the hearts of all countries.

Not to mention anything else, just say that the Chu country where Qianye is located, in a county of the Chu country, there will not be more than ten first-class masters. The entire Chu State is only more than ten counties, and all the first-class masters are combined, and there are only two hundred people. Among them, it is estimated that there are no more than seventy or eighty people who can be controlled by the King of Chu and obey his orders.

Even if Chu State is like this, other countries are probably not much different, or even far worse.

Such a powerful force, Li Cheng alone, even with the help of the blood sword, would definitely not be able to resist it.

"Monster, it's time for your death!" Qianye shouted, his face full of righteousness.

Hearing the words of Qianye who had caused such pain to him, Li Cheng was furious. It was because of him that he was seriously injured, and he had to do his best to damage his life, and he had to burst out with such strength.

Now because of the erosion of the blood sword, Li Cheng, whose mind is a little unclear, has already turned into a demon who only knows how to kill. He doesn't know how to measure the situation, and he doesn't know that he is surrounded and in danger.

All he knew was that the ant in front of him had hurt him and caused fatal injuries to him. He wanted to give him enough punishment to tear him into pieces to calm his anger.

Li Cheng roared angrily, and swung the long sword in his hand, bringing out bursts of blood light, which condensed into a blood dragon in the air, circling towards Qianye.

The blood mist around the blood dragon surged, and with the blood dragon's flying momentum, they all attacked Qian Yezi.

Clouds follow dragons, wind follows tigers.

At this moment, the blood mist is like a cloud in the sky, and the blood dragon formed by the sword light is like a real dragon, reflecting each other, its power and momentum greatly increased, breaking through the hastily arranged defense lines, and directly attacking him.

With a puff, a blood arrow spurted out, and then the blood sword was swallowed by the blood mist and turned into nourishment.

As for Qianye, who sprayed out the blood sword, she flew backwards and fell more than ten meters before stopping.

However, his condition was not very good, pools of blood flowed out from the wound, and the blood dragon transformed by the sword light had poured into his limbs, constantly destroying his body. The blood fog following the blood dragon continued to erode his whole body, devouring the blood and flesh in his body, causing his body to dry up quickly, turning him into a mummy at a speed visible to the naked eye.

And all of this happened in just three breaths.

Behind him, before the people who came to help Qianye arrived, Qianye was already dead.

"Here, Fellow Daoist Qianye!" A middle-aged man in a green robe rushed over with a long blue sword in his hand, but he didn't expect that the person he helped had fallen, and he was horrified.

"You demon, you are so cruel. If you don't kill me today, I will not give up!" Afterwards, the number of people who had just arrived gradually increased, and an old man in a yellow robe with gray temples said angrily.

"That's right, evil spirits and heretics, everyone can get them and punish them. Let me kill you today, so that the world will be bright and bright!" The wind drifted away, but it was extremely eye-catching in the blood mist.

Roar!

Li Cheng, who had already lost his mind, couldn't understand the polite words spoken by these people in front of him, and he didn't pay attention to them. He roared like a beast.

With his anger, the surrounding blood mist surged even more, and the color became more blood red. The redness made people feel a sense of surprise, but they found that there was a murderous intention hidden in it.

The blood mist was everywhere, and long swords were constantly condensed, and there were even grimaces hidden in the mist, waiting for an opportunity to attack.

The many people who came after him all came up with their own special moves, they were all top-notch masters, so naturally they would not be frightened by these sights and lost the courage to make a move.

On the contrary, their brave hearts were aroused even more, and the greed in their hearts increased with time.

The ability of the blood sword in front of him shows that it is extraordinary, which means that the reward given by Yu Guo is not a lie, it is very likely to be realized.

What's more, even if Yuguo doesn't reward them, if they can get this sword, study it hard and control it, their strength will definitely increase greatly, and their cultivation base will be among the top in the world.

Anyway, no matter what, as long as they can get this blood sword, they won't lose money.

In the blood mist, the brilliance suddenly appeared, and the brilliance burst out with the aura of those masters, overflowing. Countless wonders gathered, and the blood mist was scattered in an instant, full of flaws.

Although Li Cheng was even more angry and his aura was even more frightening, he could not withstand the suppression of nearly a hundred masters of the same level, and he kept falling into a disadvantage.

Time passed slowly, and in the blink of an eye, half an hour had passed.

And many disciples outside the blood mist, scattered people from all walks of life, watched the blood mist from its infancy at the beginning, to become extremely prosperous, expanding in all directions, and then leaking everywhere, until now it gradually dissipates. ,

During this process, countless shouts of killing sounded, and all kinds of terrifying momentum came and went continuously.

In the end, the blood mist gradually stopped, unable to block their sight. Looking into the blood mist through the opening, they saw that the fighting inside had come to an end.

But even so, the aftermath of this battle was terrifying, causing everyone outside the blood mist to tear their hearts apart.

And the range of blood mist as a battlefield was even more dilapidated.

The plain below the blood mist was originally covered with green grass, but now it is withered and withered, leaving only a piece of blood. Moreover, the plains are full of potholes and potholes of different sizes.

There are also many sword marks and ravines scattered in it, ten feet into the ground, which are obviously done by a master with extremely advanced swordsmanship.

After a while, the blood mist dissipated completely, revealing several figures. But in this figure, Li Cheng, who was holding a blood sword, was nowhere to be seen.

The blood sword that everyone was fighting for was also inserted in the middle of the blood mist alone, and no one cared about it.

A big battle disappears.

People outside the arena swarmed up, some of them looked happy, some looked sad, and some even drew out their long swords with a stern look on their faces.

Another battle begins here.
